metadata.description: Haittee community of trans Giri area has been accorded with ST status by the central government recently. The trans Giri area of Sirmaur is considered most backward area of the state. But this area is full of natural resources and rich culture of Haittee people. Vidyanand Sarek has done immense work to record the Haittee culture and folklores. He was given Padma Shree award by the government of India in 2022.
